April 21, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Crispin Odey increased its stake in Comcast Corp New (CMCSA) by 89.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Odey Asset Management Group Ltd bought 63,684 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Crispin Odey held 134,484 shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.39M, up from 70,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Odey Asset Management Group Ltd who had been investing in Comcast Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $154.24 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.81% or $0.27   $33.21. About 19.81M shares traded. Comcast Corporation (NASDAQ:CMCSA) has declined 11.10%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.65% the S&P500. 
Metropolitan Life Insurance Company increased its stake in Six Flags Entertainment Corp (SIX) by 392.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Metropolitan Life Insurance Company bought 19,918 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.68% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,990 shares of the services-misc. amusement & recreation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.66 million, up from 5,072 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Metropolitan Life Insurance Company who had been investing in Six Flags Entertainment Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.19 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.65% or $0.4   $61.32. About 894,936 shares traded. Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE:SIX) has risen 3.06%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.49% the S&P500. 
Metropolitan Life Insurance Company, which manages about $14.10 billion and $7.53 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Laboratory Corporation Of America (NYSE:LH) by 32,566 shares to 15,612 shares, valued at $2.49M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Four Corners Property Inc Trust by 22,905 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 22,993 shares, and cut its stake in Oasis Petroleum Inc (NYSE:OAS). 
Among 16 analysts covering Six Flags Entertainment ( NYSE:SIX ), 12 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 75% are positive. Six Flags Entertainment had 35 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Long-Term Buy” rating on Tuesday, August 23 by Hilliard Lyons. The rating was upgraded by FBR Capital on Friday, April 1 to “Outperform”. FBR Capital maintained the shares of SIX in report on Thursday, October 27 with “Outperform” rating. Wedbush maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, January 8 report. The rating was maintained by Wedbush on Tuesday, June 20 with “Outperform”. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Wedbush given on Thursday, April 28. As per Friday, August 28, the company rating was maintained by Credit Suisse. FBR Capital maintained the stock with “Mkt Perform” rating in Wednesday, October 21 report. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, July 18 report. The stock of Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE:SIX) earned “Outperform” rating by Oppenheimer on Wednesday, April 6. 
Odey Asset Management Group Ltd, which manages about $1.10 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Bank Amer Corp (NYSE:BAC) by 996,236 shares to 534,064 shares, valued at $15.77 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Banco Macro Sa (NYSE:BMA) by 16,404 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 49,000 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
